concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-touchngo-api-only]] — 2019-modified, 2026-09-15-captured MY/MYR Touch'n Go API-only redirect guide with Support-gated setup, return `/payments/details`, pending/webhook outcome branches and separate TEST/live requirements; sample v68/v72 endpoints are not a stated minimum.
warnings: RedirectShopper and returned redirectResult are not final authorization. Pending/Received wait for AUTHORISATION webhook, with a documented 30-minute offer-close condition; browser nonreturn uses webhook fallback. /payments v68 and /payments/details v72 are sample URLs, not a stated common version requirement.
